review_sources: Supabase MCP: list_tables (verbose) for schemas public, auth, storage, realtime, vault, extensions, graphql, graphql_public
Supabase MCP: list_migrations (remote migration history API)
Supabase MCP: execute_sql (pg_enum public, pg_policies public, pg_proc public, information_schema.triggers public)
meta.note: graphql / graphql_public schemas had no tables in this list_tables response; Supabase pg_graphql extension is installed (see extensions.installed).

executive_summary.application_model: Live database implements Personal Knowledgebase v2 in public: documents, document_captures, tags, document_tags, document_links. Full-text search is supported via tsvector column search_document on documents with triggers maintaining it.
executive_summary.phase1_gap: Repository code in src/lib/ingestion/repository.ts still references Phase 1 tables (sources, source_contents, ingestion_jobs, etc.) that are not present in the linked project; public schema enums from Phase 1 migrations remain in the catalog.
executive_summary.security_posture: All five public application tables have RLS disabled (PostgREST exposure risk if anon/authenticated keys are used). public.execute_sql exists and is flagged by the linter; treat as critical if executable by non-service roles. Several public functions lack fixed search_path.
executive_summary.operations: Supabase list_migrations returned an empty array for this project (remote migration tracking may differ from local supabase/migrations).

tables_verbose.name: auth.sso_providers

columns.name: resource_id
columns.comment: Auth: Uniquely identifies a SSO provider according to a user-chosen resource ID (case insensitive), useful in infrastructure as code.

tables_verbose.name: auth.sso_domains
tables_verbose.comment: Auth: Manages SSO email address domain mapping to an SSO Identity Provider.

tables_verbose.name: auth.saml_providers
tables_verbose.comment: Auth: Manages SAML Identity Provider connections.

tables_verbose.name: auth.saml_relay_states
tables_verbose.comment: Auth: Contains SAML Relay State information for each Service Provider initiated login.

tables_verbose.name: auth.flow_state
tables_verbose.comment: Stores metadata for all OAuth/SSO login flows

tables_verbose.name: auth.oauth_client_states
tables_verbose.comment: Stores OAuth states for third-party provider authentication flows where Supabase acts as the OAuth client.

codebase_cross_reference.note: If repository.ts is still used at runtime against this project, queries will fail until Phase 1 tables are created or the code path is retired.

structured_findings.summary: A function named execute_sql exists in public; combined with RLS-off tables this is a high-risk pattern if any role can invoke it.
documents, document_captures, document_tags, tags, document_links are exposed without RLS.
Six public functions including triggers and set_updated_at should use an explicit search_path.
Six indexes on public tables reported unused (may be new or low traffic).
Phase 1 ingestion tables referenced in src/lib/ingestion/repository.ts are absent from the live database; legacy enums remain.
